description: React component for displaying and managing installed incoming webhooks in Mattermost, including filtering, editing, and deleting webhooks.

classes.name: InstalledIncomingWebhook
classes.description: React component class for rendering an individual incoming webhook item with actions and details.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Function to determine if a webhook matches a given filter string based on its display name, description, and channel name.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Method to invoke the onDelete callback with the current incomingWebhook when delete is triggered.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Render method for displaying webhook details, actions, URL, and creation info, with filtering logic.
